page_title: SEV 1-2 GIR | Sevilla v Girona 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Jose Luis Mendilibar has decided to make a change. Jesus Corona (Sevilla) replaces Adria Pedrosa.
90+7' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Torre (Girona) will replace Savio.

90+7' Loic Bade (Sevilla) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Suso, but the ball goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
90+4' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+1' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Sevilla, play can continue.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Sevilla. Let’s see what happens!
90' The referee blows his whistle after David Lopez (Girona) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Sevilla!
89' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
86' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) gets to a rebound inside the goalmouth, but even from this distance he misses the target and fails to score. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
86' Savio (Girona) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the right post.
85' The ball is cleared after Yan Couto (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
84' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
82' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
81' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
79' Here is a change. Viktor Tsygankov is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Valery (Girona).
78' Michel prepares a substitution. Arnau Martinez is replaced by Yan Couto (Girona).
77' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
75' That will be all from Lucas Ocampos who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
75' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Kike Salas (Sevilla) is the recipient.
73' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
72' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jesus Navas (Sevilla). Sevilla force a corner. They send men into the box.
71' A substitution has been made. Oliver Torres goes off and Erik Lamela (Sevilla) comes on.
71' Suso (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
67' Suso (Sevilla) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
67' Suso (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
66' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' Savio (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
63' The substitution is prepared. Artem Dovbyk (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cristhian Stuani.
63' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Sevilla players look gutted.
62' Celebrations by Sevilla are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
61' Goal - 2:2! Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top right corner. Adria Pedrosa provided an assist for the goal.
61' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
59' The attendance is 29304.

59' Jesus Navas smashes in a cross, but Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
58' The yellow card goes to Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla).
58' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. Girona have been awarded a free kick.
56' 1 - 2 Goal! Arnau Martinez provides Aleix Garcia (Girona) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the top right corner. 1:2.
53' Savio (Girona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Girona get a corner.
53' A quickly taken corner by Girona.
51' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Sevilla! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Jesus Gil Manzano and both teams have no complaints.
50' PENALTY APPEAL after Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
50' Suso (Sevilla) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
46' Substitution. Yangel Herrera is replaced by Juanpe (Girona).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Suso (Sevilla) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
45+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
45+2' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is about to take a corner kick.
45+1' A nice individual effort by Suso (Sevilla) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

42' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Paulo Gazzaniga makes a comfortable save.
41' Girona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
40' An attempted cross from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared. Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
40' The resulting corner from Aleix Garcia (Girona) is cleared by the defence.
39' Savio (Girona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Corner kick. Girona will have an opportunity.
37' Arnau Martinez (Girona) gets a yellow card.
37' Arnau Martinez (Girona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Sevilla have a free kick from a promising distance.

36' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

34' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Yangel Herrera (Girona) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
34' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
32' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.

31' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.

31' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
27' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.

27' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.
26' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
25' Suso (Sevilla) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Paulo Gazzaniga stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
25' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sevilla.
23' Suso (Sevilla) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
20' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
19' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul after Yangel Herrera (Girona) hacks down one of his opponents. Sevilla win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Yangel Herrera (Girona) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
16' Aleix Garcia (Girona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
16' A cross into the box from Savio (Girona) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Girona can continue in their attacking effort.
16' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
11' Aleix Garcia (Girona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
9' Yangel Herrera (Girona) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
9' Some patient build-up play from Girona as they look to unlock the defence.
6' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will take a throw-in.
5' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
4' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle and it's Suso (Sevilla) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

1' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
1' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Girona will take the kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano will supervise the game today.
